test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, if ‘RPD’ is written as ‘43’ and ‘FCL’ is written as ‘60’, how will ‘QTS’ be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Sum of the position values of opposites according to English alphabetic series is written.

So,

 
• ‘RPD’ is written as ‘43’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30078c5b69fc81ed1ec8ee035a250063c0f396df95955e7ba086efb22d5b04f2.png] 

And,

 
• ‘FCL’ is written as ‘60'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/314a14bb80436e81b1861b23065c7b598f4a57d1dd8a4dbb327300078d7ff6b3.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘QTS’ will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fad2d128148de274f175b442ddb87095af2de3a1331e190a785ca975223281a7.png] 

​Hence, "25" is the correct answer.

5c
